planets.name: TOI-2081 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2081 with a 10.5-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-2081 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-2081. Its orbit and size follow Esparza-Borges et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname ESPARZA_BORGES_ET_AL_2022): disc_year 2022, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 10.50543617136, pl_radj 0.18199692, pl_bmassj 0.0152
